==Trivia==
*The achievement "'''Victory lies in preparation'''" was voted for by the community on [[Ubisoft]]'s official forums.{{Template:Fact}}
*"'''Perfect Harmony'''" is a reference to {{Wiki|Paul McCartney}} and {{Wiki|Stevie Wonder}}'s "{{Wiki|Ebony and Ivory}}". It became an achievement because Game Designer Patrick Plourde was "obsessed with the song."{{Template:Fact}}
